fixed_scope: Five distinct autonomous tracked desk pets with independent memory and speech, ordinary-speech interruption, consented camera, touch and handling, safe operator-enabled exploration, real key and wrapped-candy lift/grip, and one dedicated independently qualified charging dock per pet; one read-only room station shared by the fleet. The FIRST complete unit must also find, record and retrieve supported stationary objects using calibrated map anchoring, verified wheel displacement, safe known support and fresh arrival checks. Reuse existing 49 parent roles and 14 overlapping linked decisions. One fully featured core is physically qualified before the remaining four.
architecture: Mac owner for fleet/memory/AI; XIAO ESP32S3 Sense for camera, microphone, display, speaker and facial response; WROOM32 local actuator/safety controller; two isolated I2C multiplexers and reusable plug-in sensor harness.

bus.critical_policy: Firmware in code/firmware/body/TofBus and AccessorySensors already implements eight VL53L0X in esp32_full and bounded raw reads for the listed 0x71 channels including bounded PN532 toy NFC scans and a read only UID game token, but all remain unqualified on actual breakouts. 0x71 mux is quiesced ahead of critical 0x70 ToF reads; failed quiesce faults the local guard. The complete esp32_full profile additionally REQUIRES an installed fresh MCP23017 dock monitor; missing/invalid/stale GPIOA data or either seat contact locally blocks or stops motion. All source drivers require real breakout-specific voltage, lens, time, and behavior measurements and camera, remembered text, peer messages and AI must never arm the local motor guard or certify charging.
bus.head_policy: Sense camera/mic are fixed; GPIO9 can be RGB only after confirming SD disabled and actual shipped board routing. Face bus 5/6 never connected to body Wire.
bus.power_policy: One protected 1S cell/pack and charger with load sharing, 5V regulator sized to measured concurrent head/WROOM/steppers/servo/audio current, independent 3.3V sensor regulator. No bare cell charger contacts or 5V MCU GPIO.
bus.voltage_policy: Only 3.3V I2C/GPIO at WROOM. Check every generic carrier VCC rail, pullups and level shifting. GPIO34 to 39 have no internal pulls. Bumper is two NC contacts in series to ground with external 3.3V pullup; normal LOW, collision or disconnected cable HIGH, local raw trip immediately. GPIO35 is input only and has no internal pullup.
bus.pca9685_policy: Not in selected fixed head and two servo system; moving ears, tail or head pan/tilt would require separate validated actuator variant, not a surprise third servo on occupied pins.
